maria.summary: Loves Japan, cherry blossom season, vegetarian-friendly food, mid-range budget (~$3k), dislikes crowded group tours.

james.summary: European city breaks, hiking and photography, seafood lover, flexible budget, prefers autumn, favorites: Lisbon and Swiss Alps.

messages.content: I'm planning a spring trip to Japan. I loved Tokyo last year but want something quieter with temples and gardens.
Kyoto is ideal for temples and gardens in late March during cherry blossom season. Avoid peak Golden Week crowds if possible. Nishiki Market has great vegetarian street food options.
I'm vegetarian but okay with dashi in broth. Budget is around $3000 for a week including flights from SF.

Noted: vegetarian-friendly with dashi acceptable, $3000 all-in budget. Recommend budget ryokan or boutique hotels in Gion, JR Pass for day trips to Nara, and free temple walks like Fushimi Inari early morning.
The Tokyo trip was amazing but the group bus tour to Mt Fuji felt too rushed. I prefer self-guided walks and local markets.
I'll avoid packaged group tours for future plans. You enjoy photography at markets — Tsukiji outer market and Nishiki are great fits. Early-morning temple visits work well for your style.
Any good vegetarian ramen or tofu specialties in Japan you'd remember for me?
Try yudofu (tofu hot pot) in Kyoto, sesame ramen at T's Tantan in Tokyo Station, and Buddhist shojin ryori at temples. Matcha sweets at Gion are also a favorite for travelers with your tastes.
Just got back from Lisbon — loved the coastal walks and seafood. Looking for similar vibes in autumn.
Lisbon's Alfama hills and miradouros suit your photography style. For autumn, consider Porto or San Sebastián for seafood pintxos and golden-hour coastal trails.
Swiss Alps hiking in October was perfect. Moderate trails, not too touristy. Budget is flexible if the experience is worth it.
Your preference: moderate alpine hikes, October timing, quality over cost. Lauterbrunnen and Grindelwald first valley trails match well. Book mountain huts early for photography sunrise shots.
Thinking Croatia or Slovenia next — coastal towns plus day hikes. I eat seafood but also enjoy local wine tastings.
Slovenia's Lake Bled to Triglav trails plus Piran on the coast gives you both. Istrian wine country near Pula pairs well with seafood. September-October avoids summer cruise crowds.
